newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas sees no change for cargo unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas sees no change for cargo unit.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Thursday it expected revenues for its cargo services in its second half ending June 30 to be similar to those of the first half of the 1996/97 year.
"I don't have the forecasts with me, but I don't expect it to change that much," chairman Gary Pemberton told Reuters after a press conference for the release of Qantas first half results.
Qantas, which is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc, reported a three percent fall in net freight revenue to A$262.5 million in the six months to December 31, compared with a year earlier.
Pemberton said the fall in freight revenue was largely due to competition and overcapacity in the market.
